LATEST VERDICT, round 10 on bee040a, REQUEST_CHANGES (opus unit, claude-opus-5-5; the leader holds the full text; this is a faithful summary). Part 1, my delta, holds for everything round 9 named. Part 2, the principle that nothing outside a | body spans lines, does NOT hold; two holes, neither an end-to-end exploit (variableTouches still sees the name, flow env is refused). B1: the flow-collection closure count is fooled by quotes in flow context. The count deletes quoted spans wherever a quote appears, but in flow context a mid-scalar quote is plain text and an entry-start quote is a scalar that may span lines. (a) mis-paired quotes, for example a flow sequence opening with an apostrophe word then a quoted closing bracket, continued on the next line with a mapping entry and an alias; the count leaves a balanced remainder. A mapping form exists too. (b) an unterminated entry-start quote closed on the next line, or a block-scalar variant where the escaped text is the body. Suggested fix if the line-regex approach stays: inside a flow value a quote opens a scalar only at an entry start and must close on the line; refuse any other quote character. B2: a keyless nested-dash block scalar gets the wrong body column: for a dash-dash-pipe header the key column is the OUTER dash column, so a following sibling dash line lands in the body and skips every rule while YAML ends the scalar and reads it. Unchanged since round 4/5. Fixture: red on bee040a; a properly indented dash-dash-pipe body must stay accepted. Non-blocking: N1 BLOCK_HEADER key class narrower than KEY (harmless); N2 the expression mask in the count is dead in effect; N3 refuses a flow entry with a quoted string holding a hash (strict); N4 BLOCK_HEADER accepts some invalid indicator combinations (UNMEASURED, harmless if GitHub errors).

PENDING DECISION, NOT MINE: the leader is taking the APPROACH to opum-doc, because rounds 6-10 each found a new hole in the line-regex checker. The answer may change what to build: keep patching the line scanner (fix B1 and B2 as above, expect more rounds) versus a different shape (a stricter layout allowlist with a stated threat model, or a parser, which is a dependency change and a DEC-182 (1) matter that goes to opum-doc). Do not merge until the leader relays an approving verdict.
